note: Majority: the Civil Code (Občiansky zákonník, Act No. 40/1964 Coll.), § 8(2): majority at eighteen, or earlier only by marriage (not held); version in force from 31 July 2026. Work: the Labour Code (Zákonník práce, Act No. 311/2001 Coll.), version in force 1 September to 1 December 2026, § 11(2): capacity as an employee from the day a person turns 15, though no start before the end of the last year of compulsory schooling. § 11(4) and (5): a person under 15, or still in compulsory schooling, may do light work only in performing in cultural and artistic performances, sports events and advertising, and only with a permit the competent labour inspectorate gives on the employer's request, with the public health authority's agreement, setting hours and conditions; no lower age is set. Service: the Act on Military Duty (Act No. 570/2005 Coll., version in force 1 June 2022 to 30 June 2025, the latest the Slov-Lex static store served; later versions weren't found by date) holds call-up (odvod) and extraordinary service only in time of war or state of war (§ 5(1)); no peacetime service, so none. Registration duties aren't held. Read from Slov-Lex, the Ministry of Justice's legal portal.
